theme_strategy.archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC UTILITY (Document Studio Precision)
theme_strategy.rationale: An internal document utility tool (iLovePDF clone for local corporate network) demands utmost operational clarity, high contrast, crisp typography, and zero distraction. A refined light theme with deep charcoal anchors, warm stone undertones, vibrant Swiss cinnabar/crimson accent (#E11D48 / #E63946) for PDF/action cues, and emerald/cyan for success and document formats.

entry_surfaces./: Document Studio Hub: Swiss Precision Topbar with ES/CA Language toggle, Hero statement with local-network badge, Interactive Bento Grid of 5 primary tools (Word to PDF, PDF to Word, Merge PDF, Split PDF, Images to PDF), and an instant drop-and-convert drawer.
entry_surfaces./word-to-pdf: Focused workspace: breadcrumb header, high-capacity drag-and-drop zone with DOCX preview, conversion progress bar, auto-download switch, and result summary with manual download fallback.
entry_surfaces./pdf-to-word: Focused workspace: breadcrumb header, drag-and-drop zone for PDF files, real-time OCR/conversion progress, page count display, and one-click DOCX download.
entry_surfaces./merge-pdf: Multi-file workspace: drag-and-drop zone for multiple PDFs, visual list with reorder/drag handles, page count tallies, merge button, real-time progress, and merged PDF output.
entry_surfaces./split-pdf: Precision splitting workspace: PDF uploader with page count detection, interactive mode toggle (Split by page ranges vs Extract every page vs Single page extraction), page thumbnail preview mockup, validation and ZIP/PDF download.
entry_surfaces./images-to-pdf: Image compilation workspace: multi-image dropzone (PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP), image reordering thumbnails, orientation selector (A4 Portrait/Landscape/Fit to Image), margin options, progress bar, and PDF compilation download.

accessibility_and_testing.wcag_compliance: WCAG AA compliant contrast (>4.5:1 on text, >3:1 on controls). Visible focus rings with outline-offset-2. Aria live regions for progress updates.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. BILINGUAL SUPPORT: Implement an active language context (Spanish / Catalan) with fallback to localStorage. All UI labels, tool descriptions, buttons, tooltips, error messages, and success notifications must switch dynamically and remember the preference.

2. 100% LOCAL PROCESSING (NO EXTERNAL APIS): Implement backend endpoints in FastAPI for DOCX→PDF (using python-docx / libreoffice / docx2pdf / reportlab / pdf2docx), PDF→DOCX (using pdf2docx), PDF Merge (using pypdf / PyPDF2), PDF Split (using pypdf), and Images→PDF (using Pillow / reportlab / img2pdf). Ensure temporary files are securely created in a temporary directory and wiped immediately after streaming or via background cleanup task.
3. FILE SIZE LIMIT: Strictly enforce 100MB maximum file size with clear client-side validation and backend 413 error payload.

4. DRAG & DROP & PROGRESS: Create a rich drag-and-drop zone using standard HTML5 drag events or react-dropzone. Provide realistic step-by-step progress bars (0% → 30% uploading → 70% processing → 100% ready) and automatic download triggering using invisible anchor tag with fallback button.

5. VISUAL REORDERING FOR MERGE & IMAGES: For 'Merge PDFs' and 'Images to PDF', show list of added files with thumbnail/icon, file size, drag-and-drop or up/down arrow reordering, and individual remove buttons.
6. SPLIT OPTIONS: Support 3 splitting modes: a) Extract custom range (e.g., '1-3, 5, 8-10'), b) Split into individual single-page PDFs (downloaded as a ZIP), c) Split at fixed intervals.
7. MODERN SWISS LOOK: Use Plus Jakarta Sans for headings, DM Sans for text, JetBrains Mono for file metrics. Use crisp borders, subtle shadows, and rose/crimson accents for PDF branding.
8. TESTS & ATTRIBUTES: Ensure all interactive controls have data-testid attributes matching accessibility_and_testing.data_testids.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.code_standards: Strict TypeScript, no 'any', type all API payloads and handlers. Use FastAPI APIRouter prefix='/api' and mirror interfaces in frontend/src/lib/api.ts.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.cleanliness: Automatic temporary file deletion using Python tempfile / background cleanup tasks to ensure zero data retention on local server storage.
